description: Extract guest reviews from TripAdvisor hotels, restaurants, attractions and tours by URL or location ID.

keyword.description: Only collect reviews containing this text. Leave empty for all reviews.
keyword.title: Keyword

maxReviews.description: Maximum number of reviews to collect from each place. The run also stops when the source runs out.
maxReviews.title: Maximum reviews per place

monthFilter.description: Only collect reviews published in these months. TripAdvisor applies this to the review submission month; the visit month is reported in travelDate. Leave empty for all months.
monthFilter.title: Months published

publishedAfter.description: Keep reviews published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Useful for scheduled incremental runs. Leave empty for all dates.
publishedAfter.title: Published after

ratingFilter.description: Only collect reviews with these star ratings. Leave empty for all ratings.
ratingFilter.title: Star ratings

reviewLanguage.description: Only collect reviews available in these languages. TripAdvisor may show a machine translation; the language each review was written in is always reported.
reviewLanguage.title: Review languages

sortBy.description: Order in which reviews are collected. 'detailed' prioritizes longer reviews; 'insightful' is accepted but currently returns the same order as 'most recent' on tested places.
sortBy.title: Sort reviews by

startUrls.description: TripAdvisor place URLs or numeric location IDs. Hotel, restaurant, attraction, activity/tour, single-review and country-domain links are supported.
startUrls.title: Place URLs or IDs

tripTypeFilter.description: Only collect reviews from these traveler types. Leave empty for all trip types.
tripTypeFilter.title: Trip types

title: TripAdvisor Reviews Scraper Input
